summary: The colour of the text, and the value of currentColor.
details: Write colours as names, hex (#f97316), rgb(), hsl() or oklch(). The value is inherited, and the keyword currentColor reuses it elsewhere, so borders, icons and outlines can follow the text colour automatically.

values.note: Near-black: softer than pure black for body text.
Same family by hue, saturation and lightness.
A blue in OKLCH: equal lightness steps look equal.
Take the parent’s colour (links and buttons have their own).

gotcha: Links and form controls set their own colour, so they do not pick up the colour of their parent. Use color: inherit on them when they should.
